source: AS 4100:2020 limit state design of steel members: φ = 0.9 on the member capacities (the method's γm0 = 1/0.9), section classification by λe = (b/t)√(fy/250) (5.2), the member slenderness reduction factor αc with αb (6.3.3), lateral-torsional buckling Mb = αm αs Ms (5.6.1.1), shear Vw = 0.6 fy Aw (5.11.4), the linear section and member checks (8.3, 8.4 conservative forms); connections and the seismic rules from the parent pack (named so)

clauses.bracing: AS 4100:2020 6.6.3 (restraint 2.5 % of the member's axial force)

sources.partialFactors: AS 4100:2020 Table 3.4: φ = 0.9 members (γm0 = γm1 = 1/0.9), bolts 0.8 (1/0.8), friction-type connections 0.7, SP category fillet welds 0.8 (field welds taken SP too)
sources.designStrength: AS/NZS 3679.1 Grade 300 (fy 320 to 11 mm, 300 to 17 mm, 280 beyond) and Grade 350 (360, 340, 330) of hot-rolled sections by flange thickness (AS 4100 Table 2.1; uncertain, to be checked)
sources.classification: AS 4100:2020 Table 5.2 (bending) and 6.2.4 (compression): λe = (b/t)√(fy/250), the program's ε = √(250/fy) units; λep as the plastic and compact limit (AS has compact, non-compact and slender only), λey as the semi-compact limit: flange outstands HR 9/16, HW 8/14, both edges supported CF 30/40, webs in bending 82/115, CHS 50/120 on (do/t)(fy/250), axial λey 45 (webs) and 82 (CHS); the web limits with axial force and the angle limits are SAEngine practice (no reduction by axial force)
sources.compression: AS 4100:2020 6.3.3: αc of λn = (le/r)√kf √(fy/250), αa = 2100 (λn - 13.5)/(λn² - 15.3 λn + 2050), λ = λn + αa αb, η = 0.00326 (λ - 13.5) >= 0, ξ = ((λ/90)² + 1 + η)/(2 (λ/90)²); αb of Table 6.3.3(1): hot-rolled I sections 0 (flanges up to 40 mm), 0.5 above; welded I sections 0.5 (SAEngine: the as-rolled plate value; 0 for flame-cut flanges up to 40 mm), channels and angles 0.5, tees 1.0, cold-formed RHS and CHS (non stress-relieved) -0.5; single angles about the minor principal axis on the longer length (SAEngine practice)
sources.tension: AS 4100:2020 7.2: φNt = min(φ Ag fy, φ 0.85 kt An fu); angles connected by one leg kt 0.85 (7.3.2: α = 0.85 × 0.85)
sources.flexure: AS 4100:2020 5.2.3: Ze of compact sections S <= 1.5 Z; 5.6.1.1: Mb = αm αs Ms <= Ms with αs = 0.6 [√((Ms/Mo)² + 3) - Ms/Mo], Mo the elastic buckling moment of the unbraced length (no load height or restraint factors: SAEngine practice), αm the program's equivalent moment factor c1 (AS 5.6.1.1(a)(iii) αm = 1.7 M*m/√(M2² + M3² + M4²) <= 2.5 not computed); noncompact sections at Ze = Z (SAEngine: the elastic modulus, on the safe side of the interpolation of 5.2.4); alphaLT, ltbPlateau, ltbBase are not read
sources.shear: AS 4100:2020 5.11.4: Vw = 0.6 fy Aw for dp/tw <= 82/√(fy/250); above, SAEngine's simple post-critical method of the family in place of 5.11.5's αv = (82/λw)² (to be added)
sources.interaction: AS 4100:2020 8.3.2-8.3.3 (section: Mr = Ms (1 - N*/φNs), linear) and 8.4.2.2 / 8.4.4.1 by their conservative linear form N*/φNc + M*/φMb <= 1 (SAEngine practice, on the safe side of the in-plane and out-of-plane capacities)
sources.slenderness: AS 4100 has no general slenderness limit: le/r 200 for compression, 300 for tension members (SAEngine practice)
